bootstrap.form: cluster bootstrap over games of the per-game summed job diffs (analyze_l3.cluster_bootstrap on per-game totals)

read.games_population: all 100 pilot games from the driver rows (games with no overturns of a class contribute 0 to that class's per-game total); NO sampling weights (pilot capture is complete)
read.lb_form: the two-sided bootstrap CI's lower bound is the one-sided 95% lower bound (the project's registered conservative stand-in); ub_form likewise the CI's upper bound
read.scoring: cap-aligned (sec.14): a label world scores 1.0 iff outcome > 0 AND it ended by turn 61, else 0; paired over worlds finished in both candidates, refusal worlds skipped (probe_label_analyze.job_diffs construction, cap_aligned=True)

sizing.form: two-sample bar vs Stage 3: PASS iff (gain_new - 0.0649)/sqrt(SE_new^2 + 0.0090^2) >= 1.645. Plan at 80% power for Delta_plan = pilot_lb - 0.0649 (never the point estimate): require Delta_plan / sqrt(SE_new(n)^2 + 0.0090^2) = 1.645 + 0.8416 = 2.4866 with SE_new(n) = SE_pilot * sqrt(100/n), SE_pilot the pilot's analytic game-clustered SE (sd of per-game totals / sqrt(100)). Solve SE_new(n)^2 = (Delta_plan/2.4866)^2 - 0.0090^2 =: R. If Delta_plan <= 0 or R <= 0: no finite n (print n = inf). Else n = ceil(100 * SE_pilot^2 / R). If n > 400: print the JOE-COST-DECISION flag (the size goes to Joe).

read.stop_rule: STOP (no Step 2) iff the total per-game gain's one-sided 95% UPPER bound (the bootstrap CI's upper bound) < stage3_gain + 0.020 = 0.0849
read.z_sentinel: se_diff = 0 with mean_diff > 0: z = 999.0 + z_nonfinite true (strict JSON everywhere; the live rule fires at any margin, the banding treats the sentinel as > 3.5)
